title: State the hybrid sender wrap and announcement rules exactly, and make Rust and Go follow them
description: State the hybrid sender wrap and announcement rules exactly, and make Rust and Go follow them
acceptance_criteria: PROTOCOL.md states the sender wrap KDF, the handshake associated data, and the 0x05 header associated data. The recipient session key still uses both shared secrets. The on-chain sender copy is X25519-only. Rust initiate accepts a recipient X25519 public key and encapsulation key. Rust X25519 discovery returns nothing for an ACPQ note. Go and Rust reject a bad ACPQ signature and accept an unsigned announcement as unverified. A TypeScript test flips ciphertext byte 78. PARITY.md counts 96 notes in rounds 41059 through 41154.
